finalists.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and decisive evidence, including brain biopsy and cerebrospinal fluid findings, that support its diagnosis.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate has strong evidence from brain biopsy and cerebrospinal fluid findings, although it is less specific than Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

finalists.label: Gliomatosis Cerebri
finalists.why: This candidate has some evidence from imaging studies, but it is less specific and decisive than the evidence for Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive evidence, including brain biopsy and cerebrospinal fluid findings, that support its diagnosis, whereas the runner-up has less specific evidence.

Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
contradict_spans: Bone marrow: Negative for lymphoma cells
